name: hyperdrain
changelog:
• Smart Pre-flight Disk Space Verification: Automatically checks available space on target drive before starting download; prevents starting if space is insufficient and alerts the user with exact required vs available storage
• Deleted / Ghost Directory Auto-Healing: Automatically falls back to closest existing ancestor directory if target or recent download folder was deleted, suppressing OS modal errors
• UI & Desktop Notification Alerts: Clear visual warning badges and error notifications for storage limits
• Resilient Multi-Threaded Engine: High-speed download optimizations with 6-worker chunking and SQLite WAL state journaling
